elements.name: functionApp
elements.label: Session Host Replacer Function App
elements.toolTip: Lists Function Apps tagged with a parent Azure Virtual Desktop host pool. The operation validates the selected app's replacer settings before making any change.

constraints.allowedValues: [map(filter(steps('target').functionAppsApi.value, (app) => and(contains(toLower(coalesce(app.kind, '')), 'functionapp'), contains(toLower(coalesce(tryGet(app.tags, 'cm-resource-parent'), '')), '/providers/microsoft.desktopvirtualization/hostpools/'))), (app) => parse(concat('{"label":"', app.name, '","description":"Resource group: ', last(take(split(app.id, '/'), 5)), ' | Location: ', app.location, '","value":{"id":"', app.id, '","location":"', app.location, '","resourceGroupId":"', join(take(split(app.id, '/'), 5), '/'), '"}}')))]

options.text: This is an operational request, not a Session Host Replacer redeployment. It schedules a one-time accelerated replacement on an existing replacer and leaves its configured continuous mode unchanged.

Maintenance replacement is supported only for DeleteFirst replacers. Scheduling is blocked when a request is already populated, Entra device cleanup is not configured for an Entra-joined pool, or the required outage acknowledgements are not selected.
The selected Function App is not configured for DeleteFirst maintenance replacement. Select a DeleteFirst Session Host Replacer.
The form read the configured Compute Gallery image definition from the selected replacer. Select the exact published version approved for this maintenance operation.

elements.name: approvedGalleryImageVersion
elements.label: Approved Image Version
elements.toolTip: Versions excluded from latest-image selection are omitted.

options.text: The selected replacer uses a Marketplace image. Enter the exact Marketplace version approved for this maintenance operation.

elements.name: approvedMarketplaceImageVersion
elements.label: Approved Image Version
elements.toolTip: Enter the exact Marketplace image version approved for this maintenance operation.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a non-empty image version using letters, numbers, periods, underscores, or hyphens.

elements.name: scheduledDateTimeUtc
elements.label: Start Date and Time (UTC)
elements.toolTip: Enter a future UTC timestamp in ISO 8601 format. The replacer begins the operation on its first timer invocation at or after this time.

options.text: The request is timer-driven. With the default 30-minute cadence, work can begin up to approximately one timer interval after the requested start time, and forced sign-out can begin up to approximately one cadence after the configured notification delay.

elements.name: windowDurationMinutes
elements.label: Maintenance Window (minutes)
elements.toolTip: Maximum time in which the maintenance operation may start new replacement work. Recovery of already removed hosts can continue after the window closes.

elements.name: maxVmsRemoved
elements.label: Maximum VMs Removed per Batch
elements.toolTip: Maximum number of session-host VMs removed before their exact-name replacements are deployed and validated.

options.text: Maintenance can notify connected users, forcibly sign them out, and intentionally reduce available capacity to zero. Schedule this only in an approved outage window.

elements.name: logOffDelayMinutes
elements.label: Notification Delay (minutes)
elements.toolTip: Time allowed after notifying connected users before the replacer forcibly signs out remaining sessions.

elements.name: logOffMessage
elements.label: User Notification Message
elements.defaultValue: Scheduled maintenance is replacing this session host. Save your work and sign out before the maintenance countdown ends.
elements.toolTip: Message sent to connected users before forced sign-out.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a message containing no more than 260 characters.

elements.name: forceSignOut
elements.label: Authorize forced sign-out after the notification delay
elements.toolTip: Required. The scheduling deployment fails unless this authorization is selected.

constraints.validationMessage: Authorize forced sign-out to schedule this maintenance operation.

elements.name: allowFullPoolOutage
elements.label: Authorize a full host pool outage
elements.toolTip: Required. Maintenance may intentionally reduce the host pool to zero available session hosts.

constraints.validationMessage: Authorize a full host pool outage to schedule this maintenance operation.

options.text: Do not schedule maintenance while shutdown-retained rollback VMs exist. The runtime checks again and fails closed rather than deleting retained rollback capacity.

elements.name: confirmNoShutdownRetention
elements.label: I confirmed that no shutdown-retained rollback VMs exist
elements.toolTip: Required. Review the replacer-managed VM resource group before scheduling.

constraints.validationMessage: Confirm that no shutdown-retained rollback VMs exist.

elements.name: replaceExistingRequest
elements.label: Replace the existing populated maintenance request
elements.toolTip: Leave cleared for normal scheduling. Select only after reviewing the existing request and its completed, expired, or pending status.

options.text: Replacing a populated request changes the replay-protected operation record. Confirm that the prior request is completed or intentionally abandoned before continuing.
